name: ATC_ENTITLEMENT_OBJ_REFS
description: stores info about the  object references of entitlement , benefits or conditions

columns.name: ENT_OBJ_REF_ID
columns.description: Unique row id for the object assosiated to entitlement, benefit, or condition

columns.name: ENT_OBJ_REF_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the assosiated object to entitlement,benefits or condition

columns.name: ENT_OBJ_REF_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the assosiated object

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: AT_REFERRED_TYPE
columns.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of assosiated object

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: indicates the unique identifier of entitlement resource or entitlement benefit or condition

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the type of the entity to which it is associated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VERSION_STATE
columns.description: Used to indicate the current version state of the Entity
